models.title: Operating lease right-of-use amortization from lease cost
models.summary: In the example, right-of-use amortization is the payment less the interest component; the fixed payment equals the single lease cost.

relationship.original_equation: ROU amortization = straight-line lease cost - lease liability interest accretion
relationship.locator: Leases note, operating lease subsequent measurement
relationship.translation_notes: The interest component is an input to the combined operating lease cost and is not separately presented as interest expense.

Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: The operating lease is unmodified, not impaired and its single lease cost is measured on the stated straight-line basis.
Amounts refer to the same lessee, period and lease.
limitations: Expense need not equal the cash payment for uneven payments, incentives or other timing differences.
The ROU asset need not equal the liability when there are prepaid payments, incentives, initial direct costs or impairment.
